name: season_calendar_update
title: Update the season calendar
description: Add, move, or cancel one dated event on the season calendar page.

arguments.name: event
arguments.description: What is happening, in the words you would use on the page.

arguments.name: date
arguments.description: When it happens, e.g. "Fri 12 October". Leave empty if you are only cancelling something.

template:
Read the editing guide first, then read the season calendar page.

Update it for this event: {{event}}, on {{date}}.

Keep the page's existing date format, weekday abbreviations, and section order. Show me the diff and the confirm link before anything is published.

name: seasonal_refresh
title: Seasonal refresh
description: Sweep the site for wording that has gone stale since last season.

arguments.name: season
arguments.description: The season we are now in, e.g. "2026–2027".

template:
Read the editing guide first.

Search the site for wording that has gone stale now that we are in the {{season}} season: last season's dates, past events described as upcoming, and any "this year" that now means last year.

List what you found before proposing anything, then propose the changes as one edit with the diff and the confirm link.

name: program_page_update
title: Update a program page
description: Change the summary or details on one program's page.
